channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in United Kingdom
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: JAZZ Apple UK: win a treadmill – JAZZ Apple (T&G Global)
item.description: Prize: A compact treadmill with 5% incline for home or office. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Answer the question on the JAZZ Apple UK competition page correctly to be entered into the prize draw. One entry per person, UK residents. Closes 11.59pm on Monday 30 November 2026. No purchase necessary

item.title: Rachel Ellen Designs Christmas Giveaway 2026: win 17 festive goodies – Rachel Ellen Designs Ltd
item.description: Prize: One winner gets a bundle of 17 Christmas items (colouring and activity books, crafting and decorating sets, festive hair accessories and more). Deadline: December 7, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Christmas Giveaway page (also signs you up to the Rachel Ellen Designs newsletter; existing subscribers can enter too). One entry per person. No purchase necessary. UK residents 18+. 21 Nov – 7 Dec 2026 11:59 pm UK time; winner drawn 8 Dec

item.title: PrintMedia Christmas Prize Draw 2026: win a £75 M&S gift card and Eccles cakes – SJL PrintMedia Ltd
item.description: Prize: One prize: a £75 Marks & Spencer gift card plus Eccles cakes. Deadline: December 18, 2026. Send an email to marketing@printmedialtd.com with "PrintMedia Christmas Prize Draw" in the subject line saying you would like to enter (or use the entry button in a PrintMedia email). One entry per person. UK residents 18+. Opens 6 December 2026, closes 5pm UK time on 18 December 2026. No purchase necessary

item.title: Trygghetslagret Black Friday competition: win a gift card worth NOK 10,000 – Trygghetslagret
item.description: Prize: Gift card(s) worth NOK 10,000 in total (paid in the GBP equivalent at the Norges Bank rate on 2 Dec 2026) at a shop or service the winner chooses; one winner across Norway, Sweden and the UK. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Enter free without purchase by emailing your full name, country of residence and confirmation that you are 18+ and have read the terms to support@trygghetslagret.com with the subject «BF26» (English accepted). Buying an emergency radio or sleeping bag also enters you, with equal odds. No newsletter needed. One entry per person. 18+, resident in Norway, Sweden or the UK. UK: 19 Nov 23:00 – 30 Nov 2026 22:59 GMT; draw 2 December

item.title: NFU Buy My Turkey 2026: win a British turkey from a local producer – National Farmers’ Union (NFU)
item.description: Prize: A turkey to feed 8–10 people from the winner's local turkey producer (or a producer that delivers nationally). Deadline: December 6, 2026. Complete the NFU «Buy my turkey» competition entry form (linked from the T&Cs on nfuonline.com) between 6pm on Thursday 26 November and 11:59pm on Sunday 6 December 2026. Free entry, one entry per person, UK residents aged 18+. Winner drawn at random and emailed on 7 December

item.title: Harley Street BID Christmas Advent Calendar 2026: a local prize every day, 1–12 December – Harley Street BID (London)
item.description: Prize: One prize per day from local businesses, e.g. an overnight stay for two at The Welbeck Hotel, afternoon tea for two at The Mandeville Hotel, a Natura Bissé facial at John Bell & Croyden, a terrace experience for two at Orrery, a £50 Travellers' Tales gift card and an Aesop body care duo. Prizes are collected from the Harley Street BID office (37 Harley Street, London W1G 8QG). Deadline: December 12, 2026. From 1 to 12 December 2026, open the day's door in the online advent calendar (link on the Harley Street BID page) and enter the draw with your name, email and company. Free; one entry per day, you may enter on multiple days. Entrants are subscribed to the monthly newsletter. Instagram/LinkedIn follows and the Rewards app are optional extras

item.title: yes merino «Kiwi Xmas in the UK» giveaway: win Lamington Kiwi Christmas merino socks – JUME LTD (yes merino)
item.description: Prize: 3 winners: one family pack of four pairs of Lamington Kiwi Christmas merino socks (two adult, two baby/children) and two winners of one pair each. Deadline: December 7, 2026. Complete the giveaway form on yes-merino.com/pages/kiwi-xmas-in-the-uk-giveaway and nominate a recipient with a UK delivery address (UK residents may nominate themselves). Alternatively enter via the Facebook or Instagram giveaway post (optional). No purchase necessary. 18+. 16 November – 7 December 2026 23:59 GMT

item.title: Baum und Pferdgarten Advent Competition 2026: win a €670 discount code – Baum und Pferdgarten A/S
item.description: Prize: 4 vinnere (én ved hver trekning 27.11., 4.12., 11.12. og 18.12.2026) får hver en rabattkode verdt EUR 670 til baumundpferdgarten.com (kun produkter, én ordre); konkurransen er felles for flere land. One entry per person; your entry is included in all later draws. Open to residents of Denmark, Germany, Sweden, Belgium, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, the US and Australia. 11 November – 18 December 2026 12:00 CET

item.title: Silverstone Christmas Giveaway 2026: karting, F1-style drive, WEC tickets and a stay at Escapade – Silverstone Circuits Limited
item.description: Prize: One winner: 2 × Kart Silverstone Adult Open Laps, 2 × Drive Silverstone Formula Single Seater experiences, 2 × General Admission tickets to the 2027 FIA WEC 6 Hours of Silverstone (23–25 April 2027), 2 × Silverstone Museum tickets and an overnight stay for two in a Residence at Escapade Silverstone with breakfast (transport not included). Deadline: December 20, 2026. Complete the Silverstone Christmas Giveaway 2026 entry form on silverstone.co.uk (first name, last name, email) or the official Meta Instant Form in Silverstone ads. Marketing opt-ins optional. Free. One entry per person. UK residents aged 18+. 17 November – 20 December 2026 11:59 GMT

item.title: Racewall's 12 Days of Christmas Giveaway 2026: 12 prize draws incl. a Full Season Pass – Cowdenbeath Racewall
item.description: Prize: 12 prizes drawn every second day 2–24 December 2026: Racewall hat (2.12), hoodie (4.12), hat & hoodie (6.12), adult tickets (8.12, 10.12), family tickets (12.12, 14.12), VIP suite for a domestic meeting (16.12), family ticket to the 2026 Banger World Cup (18.12), Championship adult weekend ticket (20.12), Championship family weekend ticket (22.12) and a Full Season Pass (24.12). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Fill in the Racewall questionnaire (Google Form linked from racewall.co.uk/news/xmas2026: name, email, phone, post code and survey questions). One entry per person; the earlier you enter, the more draws you are in, and you can win more than once. No purchase necessary. UK residents aged 18+. Entries by 11am on 24 December 2026. Racewall is at Central Park, Cowdenbeath, Fife

item.title: The Royal Mint 12 Days of Christmas Prize Draw 2026 – The Royal Mint Limited

Open all 12 doors (and meet the T&Cs) for the Golden Door draw. Free, no purchase. UK residents 13+ (under-18s need parental permission). One instant prize per person and address

One standard entry per person; no purchase necessary (orders over £500 give one extra entry). Marketing opt-in is optional. UK residents 18+. Closes 30 January 2027 at 11:59pm; winner drawn at random after closing.

Everyone who enters by 1 December is in every daily draw from 1 to 12 December (1pm UK time); later sign-ups join the remaining draws. The 12th-day Wishlist prize additionally requires picking four products and emailing the wishlist to another person (optional). No purchase necessary.

Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

Free, no purchase. 18+ with a valid email address; signing up includes the National Park newsletter (optional extra newsletter box for more prizes).
